note: Declares save fixtures and the runtime properties later experiments are allowed to rely on. Every fixture is pinned by size and SHA-256. A fixture is either committed (storage 'repository', with a relative repository_path, always verified) or maintainer-supplied (storage 'operator-supplied', verified when provided).

roles.single-planet-causal: Bounded per-planet causal/runtime observation. One player-owned planet is sufficient.
roles.m1-multi-planet: M1/V1 acceptance. Must support two player-owned planets holding different automation profiles at the same time.

runtime_properties.note: RE4 established Xerxes I as a player-owned planet record in this save. That it is the ONLY player-owned planet is established by the RE5 follow-up in PR #18, which is not yet part of the supported repository state, so these properties stay unverified here and are promoted when that lands.

limitations: Believed to hold exactly one planet with owner 0, so no two player-owned planets can hold different automation profiles at the same time. Pending confirmation in the supported repository state.
If that holds, the player-race pass over the planet array visits a single record, so no same-race two-sided record bracket exists in this save.
